newsitem.title: CHINA: China says politics obstacle to WTO entry.
newsitem.headline: China says politics obstacle to WTO entry.

text.p: China said on Tuesday it was fully qualified to enter the World Trade Organisation (WTO) but that politics and excessive demands on its entry were blocking its membership in the trade body.
"Some Western countries consider that there are some difficulties and obstacles in our entry to the World Trade Organisation," Foreign Ministry spokesman Shen Guofang told a regular news briefing.
"These obstacles are mainly due to political reasons and the excessive demands placed on China," Shen said. He did not name the countries creating the obstacles.
Keeping China out of the WTO would hinder the development of the global trade body and would not be beneficial to trade and cooperation between China and WTO member nations, Shen said.
Shen said China hoped a WTO ministerial meeting under way in Singapore would give impetus to China's entry into the WTO.
"We are fully qualified to enter the World Trade Organisation," Shen said.

China has been pushing to enter the WTO on the favourable terms granted to developing nations, but many Western countries, most notably the United States, insist China's economy is too large for such treatment.
